text:
alex.g: Quick heads-up — noticed a 12% regression in token-level tail latency on the streaming path after yesterday's kernel-selection change. dashboard shows spikes at 09:15 UTC.

maria.s: ugh, saw that too. is this the new heuristic that prefers fused-gemm on 80% of requests?

kenji: looks correlated with increase in KV miss rate for long-context sessions ( > 2k tokens ). KV miss ratio jumped from 3% -> 9% around the same time.

alex.g: attaching the PromQL I used: ```sum(rate(stream_token_latency_bucket{le="0.2"}[5m])) by (route, kernel_choice) / sum(rate(stream_token_latency_count[5m])) by (route, kernel_choice)```

samira: can you paste the grafana panel config? want to add per-route breakdown (chat vs completion)

alex.g: Panel filters: route=~"/v1/chat|/v1/completions", group by kernel_choice, kv_hit. Also added a custom stat: stream_chunk_server_delay_ms = server_chunk_sent_ts - server_chunk_requested_ts

perf-bot: NOTE: regression alert created (alert_id=a-2026-03-17-18). Trigger condition: p99(stream_token_latency_ms) > 120ms for 10m

maria.s: quick trace from a problematic request (anonymized): ```[trace-id=abc123] client->server: open_stream @ 10:14:33.120
server: kernel=fused-gemm v2, batch_size=8, kv_hit=false
server: first_chunk @ 10:14:33.223 (server_processing=103ms)
server: second_chunk @ 10:14:33.540 (server_processing=317ms)
client: ack_second_chunk @ 10:14:33.548 (client_network=8ms)
```

kenji: that second chunk server_processing time looks like a kernel fallback path. maybe we hit a slower memory-copy branch when KV miss forces full attention recompute

samira: can we add a label to token latency metrics: kernel_path={fast,fallback,quant}? then we can alert on fallback fraction rising

alex.g: good idea. also proposing a new panel: streaming gap CDF showing client vs server contributions. PromQL: ```histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(stream_chunk_gap_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route, contribution))``` where contribution={client_recv,server_compute,network}

ops-bot: FYI deploying a small tweak to kernel selector param: prefer_fused_threshold=0.7 -> 0.75, canary to 10% of traffic on region-us-west2 at 10:40 UTC

maria.s: before we ramp, let's add a short-lived trace tag to capture kv_cache_size, active_batch, and kernel_choice. helps link latency spikes to cache pressure

kenji: also saw batching heuristics prioritizing packing by seq_len but ignoring kv_cached_prefix_len. patch incoming to weight kv_cached_prefix_len * 0.6 in packer score.

alex.g: i'll update dashboard to show kv_miss_ratio and kernel_fallback_rate side-by-side. proposed alert: if kernel_fallback_rate > 5% AND p95(stream_token_latency) increases > 20% within 15m then page oncall.

samira: add a streaming-specific SLI: successful_chunk_rate >= 99.5% and mean_client_ack_lag < 40ms.

maria.s: ack. can someone run perf profile on the fallback kernel path? I can help instrument flamegraphs.

kenji: i'll run `perf record -F 99 -a -g -- ./serving --canary-kernel=fallback` and upload flamegraph in thread when ready

alex.g: thanks — once we have flamegraph + kv hit breakdown we can decide whether to revert selector tweak or adjust batcher score.

samira: small follow-up — if anyone touches streaming metrics, please follow metric naming guide: prefix `stream_` + suffix `_ms` or `_count` and include `route` label. avoids confusion with non-streaming token metrics. :white_check_mark:

perf-bot: regression alert auto-notes: linked runbooks/streaming-debug.md and recent canary changelog

alex.g: cool. leaving this thread open for traces/flamegraphs. thanks all. :thumbsup:
